__baseline_prompt__.text: A photographic folk-horror scene at a sunlit rural harvest gathering: a fictional adult woman has reached the seed-levy table, where the villagers wait for her contribution. Use the supplied image as the visible face and hair reference: her soft oval face, large brown eyes, small softly rounded nose and full pink lips remain recognizable, together with her dark chin-length bob and fine separated bangs. Her individual presence is quiet and magnetic, her mouth caught at the beginning of a courteous smile while tension gathers between her brows. A cream cotton dress, loosened at the collar by the afternoon heat, sits naturally on her shoulders. At the near end of a weathered wooden table she holds a little mound of dark seeds in both cupped hands above an empty shallow earthen dish. Her forearms extend from her own shoulders, bent elbows close to her waist; both wrists and the seed-filled palms are visible together. Her feet stand on level dry ground and her body has drawn back slightly while her hands remain offered over the table. Across from her, several adult villagers in pale everyday festival clothes stand close together, smiling patiently and directing their faces toward her hands. Their own identical dishes are already full, arranged at even intervals along the table; her empty dish interrupts the sequence. The pause has made an ordinary contribution feel like a decision she cannot take back. Cut wheat and stubble stretch behind the group, with a modest garland of dried stalks marking the gathering place. Clear high summer daylight, pale gold and chalk white against muted green, grain dust caught on the rough tabletop. Frame her from just below the knees upward with her face, both hands, empty dish and the watching villagers sharing one readable plane. A natural 50mm photographic perspective, crisp foreground relationships and gently legible background faces, restrained film grain, tactile skin and cloth, the bright hospitality held a fraction too still.
